ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_SEC
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
AS(
SELECT 
     BSA.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BSA.ACCTNAME AS CustomerAccountName
    ,BSA.DATE_OPEN AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
    ,BSA.DATE_CLOSED AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
    ,convert(varchar,BSL.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
    ,BSA.CURRCODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BSA.ACCTTYPE AS CustomerAccountTypeId
    ,BSA.CNAME AS CustomerAccountShortName
    ,BSA.LAST6_ACCT_NUM AS Last6AccountNumber
    ,BSAD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSA.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSA.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSA.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS_DELTA BSAD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSAD.ACCTCODE AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 
WHERE BSL.LINKCODE = 'P' OR BSL.LinkCode IS NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,CustomerId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,Last6AccountNumber
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,CustomerId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,Last6AccountNumber
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
     CustomerAccountName = SRC.CustomerAccountName
    ,CustomerAccountOpenedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
    ,CustomerAccountClosedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountClosedDate
    ,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber = NULL
    ,CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
    ,ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL
    ,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId = NULL
    ,LedgerId = NULL
    ,LedgerAccountNumber = NULL
    ,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
    ,CustomerAccountTypeId = SRC.CustomerAccountTypeId
    ,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber = NULL
    ,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BranchId = NULL
    ,CustomerAccountShortName = SRC.CustomerAccountShortName
    ,Last6AccountNumber = SRC.Last6AccountNumber

FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  ;


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccount  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,Last6AccountNumber
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName AS CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId AS CustomerId
,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,NULL AS LedgerId
,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId AS CustomerAccountTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,NULL AS BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName AS CustomerAccountShortName
,Last6AccountNumber AS Last6AccountNumber
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');



DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

END
